name: External Notification Type 1 Code
definition: Specifies the notification type, as published in an external notification type code set.|External code sets can be downloaded from www.iso20022.org.

ATAC.name: Account Terms And Conditions
ATAC.definition: Notification of new or amended terms and conditions for an account.

SUSP.name: Suspension
SUSP.definition: Notification of a process suspension due to an incident.

COUP.name: Contact Details Update
COUP.definition: Notification of new or amended contact details.

ADDR.name: Change Of Address
ADDR.definition: Notification of a change of address.

TERM.name: Service Termination
TERM.definition: Notification of termination of a service, such as an account closure.

SSIS.name: Standing Settlement Instructions Update
SSIS.definition: Notification of a change to Standing Settlement Instructions (SSIs).

MERG.name: Advice Of A Merger
MERG.definition: Notification of a merger and any associated changes.

SYST.name: System Access Request
SYST.definition: Request for access to a system.

OPEN.name: Change Of Bank Branch Opening Hours
OPEN.definition: Notification of a change to opening hours.

INCH.name: Industry Changes
INCH.definition: Notification of any pertinent industry or market changes.
